model.name: U-Net, MobileNet v1 0.25 encoder, round 7 (rounds 1-6 answers; boundary-weighted loss; context negatives)

detectionRule: seeds prob >= 0.6 grown into prob >= 0.35 (hysteresis); NAIP near-infrared NDVI > 0.12 (trees, grass) removed; cut back at OSM streets and buildings; dilation bug fixed; outline in the lot's own orientation: oriented rectangle, rectilinear polygon (all corners 90 deg, small steps smoothed at 3-15 px blocks) or a simplified hull only when no corner is sharper than 85 deg; best IoU with the detected area wins with a small per-side penalty
